title: Talent Specialist
description:
Talent Advisor & Specialist – Strategic Pharmaceutical RPO

As a Talent Advisor & Specialist, you will be the primary point of contact for full-cycle recruitment in Brazil within a high-performance RPO model. Partnering with hiring managers at a world-leading biopharmaceutical company, you will recruit for mission-critical, high-science roles.

This is a consultative role for a recruiter who acts as a strategic bridge between candidate excellence and complex business needs. You will operate in a "white-glove" environment where market intelligence and senior stakeholder management are just as important as the hire itself.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Niche Recruitment: Ownership of the full recruitment lifecycle for highly specialized roles, including Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs), HCP Partners, Clinical Research, and senior leadership.
  • Strategic Stakeholder Management: Act as a consultative partner for global hiring managers (US/Europe). Lead intake meetings, define sourcing strategies, and provide market data to influence hiring decisions.
  • Market Mapping & Hunting: Proactively identify and engage passive, high-level talent within the neurology, immunology, and rare disease sectors.
  • Candidate Experience & Logistics: Manage a premium candidate journey, from initial engagement through offer negotiation and pre-boarding.
  • Performance Excellence: Ensure alignment with aggressive KPIs, including a 10-day shortlist target and a 30-day average Time-to-Fill.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience, ideally within an RPO or executive search environment.
  • Industry Expertise: Direct experience recruiting for Pharmaceutical or Life Sciences companies is highly preferred (understanding roles like MSL or Regulatory Affairs is a major advantage).
  • Bilingual Communication: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is mandatory for reporting to and collaborating with global stakeholders.
  • Seniority: Proven ability to manage the recruitment of Director-level and highly technical scientific profiles.
  • Tools: Mastery of LinkedIn Recruiter and global ATS systems (Workday, SuccessFactors, or Gupy).

Compensation & Work Model

  • Base Salary: R$9,000.00 (Monthly CLT).
  • Model: Hybrid (Barra Funda, São Paulo). Requires on-site presence twice a week.
  • Benefits: Complete corporate benefits package.

Why You'll Succeed

  • Global Visibility: Operate within a strategic, multi-market RPO model with direct exposure to international leadership.
  • Specialized Impact: Build the teams responsible for delivering life-changing medications in Neurology and Immunology.
  • Defined Performance: Work in an environment with clear SLAs and data-driven success, where your efficiency is recognized and measured.
  • Career Growth: Join a long-standing, stable account with significant investment in professional development.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we're looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you're responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You're motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer's secure environment, so you're prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.
You'll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.
Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager(Federal DoD and/or Civilian), you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account.
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information
The Team
Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.
As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won't find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn't committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You're an amazing sales person – you're just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.
Our Commitment
We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
Palo Alto Networks is evolving and changing the nature of work to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we've rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.

description:
Oportunidade de atuação em projeto — Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior

Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e Inteligência Artificial, com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks. Atuamos em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes, priorizando inovação, colaboração, excelência técnica e desenvolvimento contínuo dos profissionais que atuam em nossos projetos.

Contexto do projeto:

Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuação em projeto de tecnologia, junto a um de nossos clientes estratégicos, com foco no desenvolvimento de soluções Full Stack, por meio de contrato no modelo Pessoa Jurídica (PJ). A atuação será remota, com foco em desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações escaláveis em ambiente cloud AWS.

Perfil técnico esperado:

1.Backend

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL utilizando Python (Flask).
  • Integração de APIs com AWS Lake Formation e Amazon Redshift para processamento e consulta de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Implementação de regras de negócio e controle de acesso com AWS Cognito.
  • Atuação com AWS Lambda e API Gateway em arquiteturas serverless.
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, performance e escalabilidade em APIs.

2.Frontend

  • Desenvolvimento de interfaces ricas e interativas utilizando React e Next.js.
  • Criação de dashboards e visualizações de dados com bibliotecas como Nivo ou Recharts.
  • Integração do frontend com AWS Cognito para autenticação e gestão de sessões.
  • Consumo de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL.
  • Garantia de responsividade e compatibilidade entre navegadores e dispositivos.

3.Conhecimentos gerais

  • Proficiência em JavaScript e TypeScript.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados e conceitos de Data Warehouse / Lakehouse (SQL e/ou NoSQL).
  • Vivência com serviços AWS, como Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito e Amplify.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban.

Diferenciais técnicos:

Você antecipa as necessidades dos clientes e fornece serviços que vão além de suas expectativas. Toma medidas rápidas e decisivas em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam os fatos. Você sempre mantém o objetivo em vista e faz um esforço extra para cumprir os prazos.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Senior ServiceNow - App Engine & Now Assist
description:

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor (a) Senior ServiceNow - App Engine & Now Assist, com forte experiência em App Engine e Now Assist para atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações corporativas, automações inteligentes e soluções baseadas em agentes de IA em um projeto estratégico junto a uma equipe multidisciplinar de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções para Automação de Processos utilizando a plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando App Engine Studio (Low-code e High-code).
  • Projetar e implementar workflows, flows e integrações (ITSM, App Engine).

  • Desenvolver componentes em UI Builder / Workspace quando necessário.

  • Apoio à disseminação de boas práticas de COE de Hiperautomação & IA;
  • Atuar como referência técnica ServiceNow no squad de Delivery;

O que buscamos?

  • Profissional com senioridade e experiência comprovada nos itens citados nesta.
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica;
  • Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e inovador;
  • Gosto por ambientes de alta performance, transparência e confiança;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão de soluções aplicadas para os negócios.
  • Comunicação clara com times técnicos e de negócio.
  • Mentalidade de inovação e automação inteligente.

Requisitos da Vaga

  • Experiência comprovada desenvolvimento na plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Experiência comprovada com ServiceNow App Engine / Creator Workflows.
  • Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Flow Designer e IntegrationHub.
  • JavaScript para ServiceNow.
  • Consumo e exposição de APIs REST.
  • Experiência com Virtual Agent, AI Search, Process Automation Designer, Performance Analytics

title: Senior Instrumentation Engineer - (Relocation to Saudi Arabia is required)
description:
Role: Senior Instrumentation Engineer

Job Description:

We are seeking an Instrumentation Engineer with extensive experience in Instrumentation utilized for the final control, monitoring and safety of Gas Plants, NGL Fractionation Plants, Refineries, petrochemicals plants, Pipelines and Distribution facilities, to join the Process Automation and Systems Division, which is part of the Process & Control Systems Department.

Process and Control Systems Department provides services in the field of process engineering, automation, new energy, and digitalization to various entities within Aramco.

As an Instrumentation Engineer your primary role will be to provide instrumentation engineering expertise to the various Aramco entities including designing, developing, installing, and troubleshooting. You will work with different disciplines such as operating sites, instrumentation engineering, facility planning, and project management. Additionally, you are expected to participate in the organization and company initiatives including safety programs, innovation programs, operational excellence, knowledge sharing, self-development and other programs as required.

Key Responsibilities:

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide support with all types of instrumentation including but not limited level, temperature, pressure, control valves, Emergency Isolation Valves, Motor Operated Valve, Relief Valves, flow measurement, level gauges etc.
  • Originate and carries out engineering studies to determine optimal solutions to complex technical problems, increase revenue, reduce cost, and improve process safety.
  • Works with and/or leads Task teams assigned to investigate incidents or solve specific technical problems.
  • Undertakes special assignments requiring extensive technical experience and discretion when dealing with outside organizations.
  • Develops and maintains Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards, Material Specifications, Procedures and Best Practices to enhance company profitability, safety, and productivity by applying and interpreting key industry codes and standards relevant to instrumentation and control.
  • Reviews and evaluates capabilities of vendors and contractors to determine their acceptability to perform major services to Saudi Aramco.
  • Acts as a Company representative in technical dealings with vendors, manufacturers, and design firms.
  • Perform technical evaluation for instrumentation quotations and attend technical bid evaluation meetings.
  • Evaluates and introduces best practices and new technologies to enable the Company to achieve Best in Class performance in oil and gas business.
  • Performs cost analyses and Value Engineering studies to recommend cost-effective solutions to technical issues.

Minimum Requirements:

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering preferably in Instrumentation, Mechanical or Electrical engineering. A Master's degree or PhD in Engineering is desired but not required.
  • Minimum 20 years of professional experience as an engineer in charge of technical work in field of specialty. Previous work with a major international Oil & Gas Company and/or previous employment with one of the Instrumentation suppliers used by Company is desired.
  • Must have experience in plant instrumentation sizing and selection (Control valves, Pressure Relief valves, Actuators, Basic Process Measurement etc.)
  • Certified in ISA- Certified Automation Professional (CAP), Certified Functional Safety Professional (CFSP), TUV FSEng, Principles & Practice of Engineering (PE) certification, or Chartered Engineer (C.E.) license or registration.
  • Basic knowledge of H2S, LEL, pH, conductivity, O2 analyzer, CO/CO2 analyzer, fire & gas detectors and Gas chromatographs is preferred.
  • Proficiency in the International codes and standards used within the oil and gas industry, i.e., API, BS, ISO, ASME, ANSI, IEC, ISA, IEEE, etc.
  • Have participated as lead engineer in HAZOP, SIL, P&ID, Design, and model reviews.
  • Understanding of control systems, compressor and pumps field instrumentation, speed controllers, Vibration Monitoring Systems (VMS), Compressor Control Systems (CCS).
  • Understanding communication protocols like DNP3, Modbus, FieldBus, TCP, IEC, SPA, RP570, ANSI and General Process Automation Protocols.
  • Have been an active member in a relevant professional society, (i.e., ISA, IEEE, etc.) for a minimum of 3 years and have been holding current membership.

title: Business Support Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.

We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Business Support Executive to join our São Paulo office.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Collections and Accounts Receivable Management

  • Perform active collections, conducting complex negotiations and proposing feasible payment alternatives.
  • Monitor the accounts receivable portfolio, aging, DSO, and delinquency, performing periodic analyses.
  • Support the definition of credit recovery strategies together with the Commercial and Finance teams.
  • Assist in managing agreements, renegotiations, and follow-ups with key clients, following leadership guidelines.

2. Contracts and Client and Vendor Relationship

  • Monitor commercial obligations within contracts, including milestones, quotations, invoices, guarantees, and deadlines.
  • Request and evaluate quotations (RFQs) and support commercial negotiations with vendors and service providers.
  • Manage and maintain relationships with vendors and suppliers, including onboarding, performance monitoring, and contract compliance.
  • Act as a liaison between Commercial, Finance, Operations, and Legal, ensuring efficient and aligned workflows.
  • Maintain a professional and cordial relationship with clients, serving as a key point of contact for financial and contractual inquiries.

3. Reports and KPIs

  • Prepare management reports on collections, delinquency, cash flow forecasts, and commercial performance.
  • Analyze trends, risks, and opportunities in the client portfolio.
  • Propose continuous improvements to collections processes and commercial workflows.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Commercial Management, or related fields.
  • Solid experience in collections, accounts receivable, commercial support, or similar areas.
  • Strong negotiation a on skills and experience handling medium and large clients.
  • Intermediate to advanced Excel skills.

title: Assistente Comercial | Mercado Financeiro

title: Tech Lead Java Backend Developer
description:
Tech Lead Java Backend Developer

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will contribute to the evolution of backend services, and APIs. You will help shape performance optimization, security, and maintainability. This role is key to delivering reliable backend solutions.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Title : Director - Regional CMC

Location : Brazil, Remote

Experience : Min 15 years in Regulatory Affairs, CMC

Director – Regional CMC

Objective:

The Director – Regional CMC will manage the Regional CMC team, ensuring seamless integration between global Regulatory CMC strategies and local affiliate execution. This role is pivotal in driving regional alignment, efficiency, and consistency in post-approval submissions across a diverse product portfolio, including small molecules, biologics, vaccines, and plasma-derived therapies. The Director – Regional CMC will champion the development and implementation of regional strategies, fostering collaboration and process improvement to meet regulatory requirements effectively and efficiently.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and manage the Regional CMC team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure high performance and professional development.
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting knowledge sharing and best practices.
  • Develop and execute a strategic vision for the Regional CMC Liaison function, aligning with global Regulatory CMC objectives.
  • Ensure the team is equipped with the necessary skills, knowledge, and resources to excel in their roles.
  • Translate global CMC strategies into comprehensive regional plans, ensuring alignment with country-specific regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of regional submission strategies to streamline processes and reduce duplication of effort.
  • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to identify opportunities for harmonization and efficiency.
  • Monitor and report on submission timelines and regulatory approvals, addressing any issues or delays proactively.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local affiliates to understand and address country-specific regulatory needs and challenges.
  • Liaise with global Regulatory CMC teams to provide regional insights and feedback, ensuring a cohesive approach to regulatory submissions.
  • Represent the Regional CMC Liaison function in cross-functional and global meetings, advocating for regional needs and perspectives.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks in the regional submission process, proposing and implementing innovative solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices and lessons learned to optimize regional submission processes.
  • Ensure compliance with regional and country-specific regulatory requirements and guidelines.

Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):

  • BS/BA Degree in a Scientific Discipline, Advanced Degree (M.S), with Ph.D. preferred.
  • 15+ years of seasoned biopharmaceutical/device industry experience or with a regulatory agency is preferred, while leading major submissions during LCM, development - including preparation of NDA/NLA/MAA.
  • Equivalent industry experience with direct technical/product development experience such as Pharmaceutical Development, Analytical Development, Production, Quality Assurance can be considered.
  • People leadership experience (5+ years) required.
  • Highly proficient understanding of scientific principles and profound grasp of global regulatory CMC requirements relevant to global drug development and post-market support.
  • Keeping abreast of industry insights and regulatory trends to drive organizational evolution.
  • Proven ability to understand and communicate regulatory strategy to drug development, registration, and post-market support teams.
  • Analyze issues with attention to detail.
  • Ability to assess and scientifically justify alternative approaches.
  • Base regulatory strategy recommendations on precedents and other regulatory intelligence as well as regulations and guidelines.

description:

Esta é uma posição estratégica, responsável por garantir fluidez, qualidade e conformidade em todas as etapas das operações de importação. Se você é um profissional proativo, detalhista e comprometido com resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades:

Diferenciais:

title: Senior Murex Integration Specialist (S4C)
description:
Project Description:

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.

Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.

Responsibilities:

- Must know the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart

- Knowledge and hands on experience in implementing, developing and supporting various MX.3 proprietary modules for Enterprise Integration such as MxML Exchange, Datamart, MX.3 Accessibility and Extensibility APIs (.Net, Java, C++, and SOAP/REST Web services), Real-time bridging service, Market Data Cache Server, MX.3 Connectivity 2.0 framework, MX.3 Packaged interfaces including (but not limited to) MarkitWire, DTCC Global Trade Repository, MarginSphere, IceLink, FXAll, Market Data Import Tool etc., MX.3 End of Day processes and Trade Life Cycle Management using workflows engine. (At least 3 years)

- Build new up / down stream integration(s)

- Convert existing integration point with Murex version change

- Development of MxML (Workflows, Exchange)

- XSL / Transformation

- Scripting (bsh, ksh, ...etc.)

- Assist existing support group(s) in resolving integration related request or issues

- Contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

- Liaise with technical team(s) -- when needed -- to resolve environment related issues and necessary enhancements in preparation for cloud deployment

- Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

1. Provide professional services to Murex clients:

o Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.

o Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.

2. Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.

o Contribute to project implementations

 Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.

 Develop trade workflows and interfaces to set up communication between external platforms and murex to receive trade and other data feeds, process them, save into the system, and send acknowledgement. Use a combination of MXMLExchange, MXopenconnect, Murex APIs, and Datamart to successfully deliver such solutions.

 Contribute to functional documentation of the test cases and use cases by the client.

 Contribute to Design documentation for the Build process of the Product.

 Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.

o Handle support cases from notification to resolution and validation.

• Participate in the business as usual and project support: follow-up of client open cases through email, CRM portal, phone-calls and on-site visits

• Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress

• Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect

Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world's best-loved brands: M&M's, SNICKERS, TWIX, MILKY WAY, DOVE, PEDIGREE, ROYAL CANIN, WHISKAS, EXTRA, ORBIT, 5TM, SKITTLES, BEN'S ORIGINAL, and COCOAVIA. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world's pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet HospitalsTM, BluePearl, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCATM and Pet PartnersTM. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English

DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we're striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Indusbello é uma empresa brasileira referência nos setores odontológico, hospitalar e veterinário, reconhecida por sua atuação inovadora na fabricação de produtos que aliam alta performance, segurança e responsabilidade socioambiental.

Com sede em Londrina (PR) e presença consolidada em mais de 30 países, a Indusbello investe fortemente em pesquisa, desenvolvimento e tecnologia, consolidando-se como uma das marcas líderes em soluções para a saúde.

Seu compromisso com a qualidade, a ética e a inovação contínua norteiam sua atuação no mercado há mais de três décadas. A empresa possui certificações internacionais como ISO 9001, ISO 13485, marcação CE e aprovação de produtos pelo FDA.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado em Administração, Engenharia da Produção, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia da Automação ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Estruturação e modelagem de processos industriais, com foco em aumento da competitividade, redução de custos e inovação tecnológica.

Principais Atividades:

  • Planejar e desenvolver projetos de estruturação e modelagem de processos industriais;
  • Propor a internalização de processos produtivos com foco em competitividade;
  • Identificar gargalos produtivos e desenvolver soluções inovadoras;
  • Implantar novos processos industriais com foco em eficiência e inovação.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise e melhoria de processos (Lean, Six Sigma);
  • Vivência em projetos de melhoria e inovação em processos industriais;
  • Análise de viabilidade e implantação de projetos de redução de custos;
  • Experiência com internalização de processos produtivos;
  • Projetos de digitalização e automação industrial.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Conhecimento avançado em Gestão da Inovação, Estratégia e Automação Industrial.
  • Conhecimento no ERP Protheus – Totvs.
  • Conhecimento em processos para produtos da área da saúde.

Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho: Híbrido em Londrina/PR (Presencial duas vezes por semana, a cada 15 dias)

Idioma: Inglês Intermediário

Soft Skills: Trabalho em equipe; Pensamento crítico; Organização; Foco em resultados; Capacidade analítica; Resolução de problemas.

Obs: Refeição no local

title: Gerente de Vendas
description:

title: Especialista em Integração / Líder Técnico de Integração
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de Especialistas em Integração / Líderes Técnicos de Integração para atuar no desenho, implementação e liderança técnica de soluções de integração robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance. O profissional será referência técnica para o time, apoiando decisões arquiteturais e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Atuação para cliente sediado em Portugal

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de integração entre sistemas e plataformas.
  • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas baseadas em eventos, mensageria e APIs.
  • Definir padrões, boas práticas e guidelines de integração.
  • Atuar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento para garantir qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos pipelines de CI/CD e processos de entrega.

Requisitos

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Solida de experiência com integrações de sistemas ( Nivel Sr/ especialista +).
  • Experiência sólida com soluções de streaming e mensageria, como:
  • Kafka, Solace, Pulsar, RabbitMQ ou similares.
  • Experiência com API Gateway e API Management, como:
  • Apigee, Kong, Gravitee ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de integração, tais como:
  • MuleSoft, Oracle SOA, Apache NiFi, Boomi, Apache Camel, entre outras.
  • Domínio de Git e pipelines de CI/CD, com forte conhecimento em práticas de integração e entrega contínua, visando otimizar processos de desenvolvimento e garantir entregas rápidas e com qualidade.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota no fuso horario de Portugal

Diferenciais

  • Atuação prévia como Tech Lead ou Arquiteto de Integração.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande escala.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (EDA) e microsserviços.

title: PROFESSOR A - ODONTOLOGIA
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.

Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.

Como será seu dia a dia:

Você atuará na área acadêmica, preparando e ministrando aulas, aplicando provas, acompanhando o desenvolvimento dos alunos sob sua responsabilidade sempre buscando otimizar o aproveitamento das aulas utilizando todas as metodologias e tecnologias disponíveis no momento.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Ministrar aulas teóricas e práticas em anatomia dental, cirurgias odontológicas, radiologia odontológica, próteses dentárias e endodontia.

- Desenvolver e aplicar planos de ensino organizados e estruturados, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado inclusivo e motivador.

- Orientar e supervisionar alunos em atividades práticas e pesquisas acadêmicas.

- Participar de reuniões pedagógicas e colaborar com a equipe para aprimorar o currículo e metodologias de ensino.

- Demonstrar liderança e flexibilidade para atender às necessidades de diferentes perfis de alunos, promovendo comunicação clara e objetiva.

Requisitos e qualificações:

- Graduação em Odontologia.

- Especialização concluída em áreas correlatas.

- Mestrado e/ou Doutorado em Odontologia, será um diferencial.

-Residir em Linhares ou cidades próximas

- Experiência comprovada em docência na área odontológica.

-disponibilidade de 6 a 9 horas semanais, no período noturno.

- Conhecimento avançado em anatomia dental, cirurgias odontológicas, radiologia odontológica, próteses dentárias e endodontia.

- Habilidades comportamentais como paciência, empatia, organização, planejamento e capacidade de liderança.

Informações adicionais:

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.
  • Seguro de Vida: Este beneficio é compulsório, a todos os colaboradores CLT, sem custo, e estão inclusos na apólice de seguro, a partir da sua data de admissão.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Chef Tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
  • Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
  • Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
  • Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
  • Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
  • Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
  • Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
  • Responsible for follow-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
  • Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
  • Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
  • Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
  • Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
  • Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
  • Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food & Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
  • Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor's instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company's rules and regulations.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION

  • A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
  • A culinary school degree is required.
  • Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
  • Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
  • Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
  • Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
  • Intermediate computer software skills required.
  • Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, "Debits/Credits", adjusting entries and corrections.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship's Senior Officers and the corporate office.

title: Pessoa Analista Financeiro Pleno
description:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou Finanças;
  • Desejável pós-graduação ou MBA em
  • Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas afins;

title: Consultor de Negócios
description:
Na Blue Health, temos um sonho grande: ser referência em soluções inovadoras para equipamentos e consumíveis médicos, democratizando o acesso à saúde na América Latina. title: Vaga para Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior (PJ) - Topshare
description:
ATENÇÃO: REQUISITO OBRIGATÓRIO

APENAS CANDIDATOS COM EXPERIÊNCIA SÓLIDA E COMPROVADA EM NODE.JS DEVEM SE CANDIDATAR.

CANDIDATURAS SEM ESTES REQUISITOS SERÃO DESCONSIDERADAS.

SOBRE A TOPSHARE E O ECOSSISTEMA CREATONOMY

A Topshare é uma plataforma de tecnologia que atua no coração da creator economy, sendo parte do grupo Creatonomy. Buscamos um profissional para atuar na arquitetura, desenvolvimento, manutenção e aprimoramento da plataforma Topshare, além de participar ativamente na criação da plataforma Creatonomy e em outros projetos estratégicos do grupo. O foco é em soluções escaláveis e de alta performance para todo o ecossistema.

Operamos em um ambiente de trabalho totalmente remoto, valorizando a flexibilidade, a inovação e a excelência técnica.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Atuar como referência técnica em arquitetura backend, liderando a concepção e a implementação de soluções robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance. O profissional será responsável por garantir a robustez, a escalabilidade e a alta disponibilidade dos sistemas, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em arquiteturas sólidas e eficientes, com foco na stack Node.js (Backend).

RESPONSABILIDADES E ESCOPO DE ATIVIDADES

1. DESENVOLVIMENTO DE BACKEND E ARQUITETURA

Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs e microsserviços robustos e escaláveis, utilizando a stack Node.js com NestJS (framework obrigatório), para a Topshare e para a plataforma Creatonomy. Isso inclui a modelagem, gestão e otimização de dados em bancos Neo4j (obrigatório) e MongoDB (desejável), garantindo a integridade e a alta disponibilidade do sistema. O profissional deverá contribuir ativamente para a definição da arquitetura de microsserviços e a evolução contínua da stack tecnológica. Será obrigatório o uso de Docker para empacotamento e execução dos serviços em ambientes isolados.

2. DEFINIÇÃO DE PADRÕES E ARQUITETURA

Estabelecer padrões de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de software e boas práticas para o backend. Será responsável por revisar e validar decisões arquiteturais, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenibilidade dos sistemas. Deverá propor e implementar melhorias contínuas na infraestrutura e processos de CI/CD.

3. QUALIDADE DE CÓDIGO E TESTES

Utilizar Git e seguir rigorosamente as boas práticas de Git Flow, realizando pull requests e code reviews de forma contínua para assegurar a qualidade do código. Será responsável por implementar testes unitários com Jest, testes de integração e testes de carga para garantir a resiliência do sistema. Além disso, deverá atuar como referência técnica, compartilhando conhecimento e propondo melhorias na arquitetura e nos processos de CI/CD.

4. DISPONIBILIDADE PARA INCIDENTES CRÍTICOS

O Contratado se compromete a responder e atuar na correção de erros, bugs ou falhas críticas de produção em tempo hábil, fora do horário comercial, quando a indisponibilidade do sistema impactar diretamente a operação ou a receita da Contratante. Esta atuação é inerente à natureza do serviço de alta disponibilidade e não configura controle de jornada.

title: Consultor (a) de Tributos Diretos
description:
Você na Deloitte

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na organização com o portfólio de serviços profissionais mais diversificado do mundo, atuando como Consultor (a) Sênior de Tributos Diretos.

Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Análises de obrigações principais e acessórias relativas a impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL);
  • Análises de consultoria e conformidade tributária;
  • Análises de contabilidade tributária;
  • Análises de controvérsias e riscos fiscais;
  • Planejamento tributário;
  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento dos trabalhos, aplicando técnicas, metodologias e práticas apropriadas, bem como orientando profissionais menos experientes quanto a sua aplicação;
  • Realização de estudos e preparação de pareceres sobre questões envolvendo a legislação tributária.

Na área de Tax & Legal, o time atua 3(três) vezes por semana em formato presencial, sejam nas dependências físicas dos escritórios da Deloitte ou de nossos clientes.

Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias. Impulsionamos talentos para que possam se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, com times diversos e que tragam energia, empoderamento, interação e conexões. O nosso crescimento é exponencial porque os talentos que recrutamos possuem os nossos valores em suas essências.

Liderar o caminho, fomentar a inclusão, colaborar para mensurar impactos, servir com integridade e cuidar uns dos outros são pontos essenciais e inegociáveis para fortalecer ainda mais o nosso propósito.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.

O que você precisa para se candidatar à vaga?

  • Experiência com revisões, recuperações de créditos e projetos relacionados à reforma tributária de impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL);
  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou Direito;
  • Inglês será considerado um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em um dos escritórios da Deloitte Brasil.

O que estará disponível para você?

Desenvolvimento profissional

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e Serviço Social

(Mais) Benefícios

  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar*
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não poderíamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida
  • Cartão Multibenefícios*

*Você receberá um valor em seu cartão e poderá distribuí-lo entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.

Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva na Deloitte Brasil

Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para reforçar esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia global D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.

Esperamos você neste time!

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client's unique needs.

We're building the infrastructure that powers smarter agency discovery, matchmaking, and evaluation—and we're looking for a developer who wants real ownership over how that system is built and evolves.

⸻

The Role

As Vendry's Developer, you'll be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the core technical infrastructure that powers the Vendry platform. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across frontend, backend, and internal tooling.

You'll manage everything from our public-facing website and landing pages to our agency portal and proprietary agency search engine. You'll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.

This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.

⸻

Responsibilities

• Own and manage Vendry's full technical stack, including:

• Frontend website and marketing landing pages

• Agency portal and internal tools

• Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine

• Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.

• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.

• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.

• Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.

⸻

Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.

• Experience working in a startup environment is a must.

• Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.

• Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.

• Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.

• Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.

⸻

Compensation

• Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.

• Full-time, remote role.

⸻

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that's redefining how brands find agency partners. You won't be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you'll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.

  • We're a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you'll feel right at home.

title: Executive - Equipment Control
description:
Job Title: Executive – Equipment Control

Department: Operations

Reporting To: Manager – Operations

Direct Reports: N/A

Job Purpose:

The Executive – Equipment Control is responsible for overseeing container equipment inventory, ensuring effective coordination with depots and state agents, and maintaining accurate, real-time tracking of container movements. The role focuses on optimizing equipment utilization, planning asset allocation, resolving operational challenges, and supporting smooth logistics operations across Brazil and neighboring regions including Argentina, Uruguay, and Paraguay.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

Equipment Inventory Management & Planning

  • Maintain and update daily container equipment inventory statistics with high accuracy.
  • Monitor stock levels and prepare equipment allocation plans based on operational demand.
  • Analyze historical data and trends to optimize equipment availability and positioning.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure efficient equipment flow.

Depot & Vendor Coordination

  • Act as the primary liaison between container depots and state agents for equipment movements.
  • Coordinate with depot teams to track inbound and outbound container flows.
  • Resolve depot-related operational issues and monitor vendor performance to ensure service reliability.

Container Tracking & Documentation

  • Update and maintain container movement logs accurately in the tracking system.
  • Ensure data integrity and investigate discrepancies in equipment records.
  • Generate regular reports on equipment utilization, stock availability, and movement history.

Issue Resolution & Process Improvement

  • Identify and resolve equipment-related operational issues in a timely manner.
  • Work closely with Operations and Commercial teams to address inefficiencies in equipment allocation.
  • Propose process improvements to enhance tracking accuracy, turnaround time, and operational efficiency.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Maintain 100% accuracy in daily equipment inventory records, with discrepancies below 0.5% per quarter – 25%
  • Submit equipment allocation plans within 24 hours, achieving at least 95% alignment with operational demand – 20%
  • Ensure 98% on-time execution of equipment movements with minimal escalations – 20%
  • Resolve 95% of reported equipment-related issues within 24 hours – 15%
  • Ensure 100% real-time container movement updates with zero data gaps – 20%

Key Interactions:

Internal: Finance, HR & Admin, Operations, Procurement, Commercial

External: Vendors, Banks, Auditors, Statutory Authorities

Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Maritime Studies, Logistics, or related field
  • Specialization in Supply Chain Management, Maritime Operations, or Business Management
  • Master's degree is preferred

Certifications & Training:

  • Professional certifications in Supply Chain Management, Maritime Operations, or Logistics (preferred)
  • Training in equipment flow optimization, compliance, and data management

Language Requirements:

  • English – Fluent
  • Portuguese – Required
  • Spanish – Optional / Advantage

Background and Experience:

Work Experience:

  • Industry: Shipping, Logistics, Freight Forwarding
  • Role Exposure: Equipment Management, Fleet Control, Logistics Coordination
  • Experience Range: 4–6 years

Core Competencies (Level 1 – Grades A–D):

  • Integrity & Accountability – Organizes work effectively, prioritizes tasks, and takes ownership of responsibilities
  • Customer Focus – Understands customer needs and ensures service delivery meets expectations
  • Continuous Learning – Actively seeks feedback, training, and applies new knowledge
  • Collaboration & Communication – Communicates clearly and supports teamwork proactively
  • Agility – Adapts to change and manages evolving operational priorities effectively

Functional Competencies:

  • Equipment Control & Management – Expertise in container inventory, allocation, and equipment flow
  • Logistics Coordination – Strong understanding of equipment movement within shipping operations
  • Data Analysis & Reporting – Ability to generate and interpret utilization and stock reports
  • Regulatory Compliance – Knowledge of industry regulations related to equipment control
  • Technology & Automation – Experience with equipment tracking systems and inventory tools

Work Environment & Specific Requirements:

  • Office-based role with regular coordination with depots, terminals, and vendors
  • Occasional travel to depots and equipment facilities as required
  • Requires strong attention to detail, coordination skills, and operational discipline

description:

A área de EHS (Environment, Health and Safety – Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho) tem como missão promover um ambiente seguro, saudável e sustentável, alinhado aos valores, exigências legais e requisitos globais da companhia.   • Apoiar na organização e gestão de treinamentos relacionados a EHS;

A PHX Consulting, oriunda do grego Phalanx, é a alavanca ideal para o ganho de eficiência e escala em médias e grandes empresas.

Com uma metodologia estruturada, ajudamos empresas a alcançar novos patamares de eficiência, otimizando fluxos de trabalho e proporcionando tomadas de decisão mais inteligentes e ágeis.

Nossa missão é tornar o Brasil mais eficiente, impulsionando a digitalização e a inovação nas empresas.

Você vem com a gente?

Sua atuação será estratégica e operacional, apoiando diretamente os sócios e líderes na gestão do time, ao mesmo tempo em que organiza rotinas essenciais de DP, compras e infraestrutura, garantindo previsibilidade e eficiência para a operação crescer de forma saudável.

  • Boa comunicação, inclusive para conversas difíceis;
  • Perfil autônomo, organizado e com visão de negócio;
  • Alinhamento com a cultura ágil, direta e orientada a performance da PHX Consulting.

RESPONSABILIDADES

Gente, Cultura & Performance
